brand_identity.name: Stellar
brand_identity.design_philosophy: Modern fintech with vibrant, approachable aesthetic combining technical sophistication with creative expressiveness
brand_identity.target_audience: Enterprise financial institutions and tech-forward organizations
brand_identity.aesthetic_inspiration: Contemporary digital art meets financial technology; accessible complexity

color_palette.color_usage: High contrast yellow against dark backgrounds creates visual hierarchy; purple used as secondary accent; minimalist neutral palette for UI elements

heading_primary.font_family: serif (appears to be a refined serif like Playfair Display or similar)
heading_primary.characteristics: Classic, elegant, premium feel; uppercase appropriate for section headers

body_text.font_family: sans-serif (modern, clean sans like Inter, Helvetica Neue, or similar)

page_layout.background: solid black with subtle texture or grain optional

hero_section.layout: centered text block followed by card grid

illustration_section.style: artistic, contemporary digital illustration with mixed media aesthetic
illustration_section.color_scheme: yellow, purple, navy with white accents
illustration_section.composition: centered, square or near-square aspect ratio
illustration_section.background_treatment: illustration integrates with transparent/black background, may have splatter or distressed edges

cta_styling.hover_state: arrow may animate or color intensify

illustrations.style: contemporary digital art with editorial quality
characteristics: Organic flowing lines combined with geometric shapes
High contrast between figure and background
Human figures depicted in dynamic poses
Integration of financial/tech symbols (buildings, coins, currency, graphs)
illustrations.rendering: polished yet artistic, not overly realistic

backgrounds.card_background: transparent or dark with subtle texture

borders_and_dividers.emphasis: achieved through color contrast and spacing

spacing_and_rhythm.visual_rhythm: generous white/black space creates breathing room; consistent gap ratios maintain harmony

links.hover_effect: arrow may shift right, text may lighten/brighten

buttons.navigation_style: minimal, text-based with hover underline or color change

responsive_design.grid_adaptation: 3 columns desktop → 2 columns tablet → 1 column mobile
responsive_design.spacing_reduction: gaps and padding reduce on smaller screens proportionally

visual_hierarchy.level_1: Hero heading (serif, large, white) - draws primary attention
visual_hierarchy.level_2: Card illustrations - emotional engagement and visual interest
visual_hierarchy.level_3: Card headings (sans-serif, bold, white) - section organization
visual_hierarchy.level_4: Body text and descriptions (secondary gray) - supporting information
visual_hierarchy.level_5: CTA links (yellow) - subtle but discoverable action points

design_patterns.hero_pattern: large heading + subtitle + spacer + content grid
design_patterns.content_pattern: left-aligned text with centered/right visual components
design_patterns.emphasis_pattern: yellow accent for CTAs and interactive elements; white for primary text; gray for secondary

accessibility_considerations.contrast_ratios: white text on black background (AAA compliant)
accessibility_considerations.color_not_only_cue: text labels + arrow icons for CTAs
accessibility_considerations.spacing: generous spacing aids readability and navigation

css_framework_notes.layout_system: CSS Grid for 3-column card layout, Flexbox for internal card spacing
css_framework_notes.animation_potential: subtle fade-ins on scroll, arrow hover animations, smooth transitions

when_replicating: Use yellow (#FFC800) sparingly for CTAs and accents
Ensure 3-column grid layout with proper gaps
Implement custom illustrations matching editorial quality and artistic style
Keep typography hierarchy clear with serif for headlines, sans-serif for body
Prioritize generous spacing and breathing room
Use high contrast for accessibility and visual impact
Keep illustrations conceptual and symbolic rather than photorealistic
implementation_guidelines.design_consistency: Maintain consistent color palette across all sections; uniform card structure; balanced use of illustration and text
